newsitem.title: USA: XOMA expands Neuprex Phase III test to U.K.
newsitem.headline: XOMA expands Neuprex Phase III test to U.K.

text.p: XOMA Corp on Friday said it expanded its Phase III clinical trial of Neuprex, a drug that helps fight severe meningococcemia in children, into the United Kingdom.
The first U.K. trial site is in London, with additional centers planned in Liverpool and Newcastle. In October, the company began Phase III trials in 16 centers in the United States and Canada.
Meningococcemia, also called meningococcal septicemia in Europe, is a bacterial infection that can kill an otherwise healthy person within hours.
An infected child usually shows flu-like symptoms and high fever, develops a septicemic purple rash, rapidly becomes unresponsive and may die within hours of onset.

The mortality rate for children can be 30 percent or more with a risk of amputations of extremities and/or permanent neurological damage among survivors. There is at present a serious outbreak of meningococcal disease in the United Kingdom, the company said in a statement.
